title: The stamp
logline: The due-date stamp itself on the librarian's desk, close, its wheels set to a date the page doesn't letter, the ink pad open. The thing that put 2004, 2011, 2019 on his card.

panels.composition: Close on a rubber date stamp with rotating wheels on a library desk, an open ink pad beside it, the wheels' digits turned away from the reader.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a rubber date stamp with rotating wheels on a library desk beside an open ink pad, the digits turned away, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
